messages:
tara: Heads-up: we have two pilots asking for Reserved Throughput. Need to pick a default packaging (pooled org-level vs per-route units).
noah: Sales: Globex wants per-route. NovaHealth prefers pooled. Both willing to pay.
linh: Eng: pooled is cheaper to implement and reduces fragmentation. Per-route adds routing state.
ben: Ops: pooled reduces risk of small reservations wasting capacity. Prefer pooled-first.
molly: Product suggestion: launch pooled SKU first + expose per-route telemetry. Price ideas: pooled 1000rps = $3500/mo, per-route 100rps = $60/mo.
pricing-bot: Sim shows pooled default improves utilization by ~8% vs per-route for SMB mix.
legal-bot: Draft clause: pooling means shared org capacity; provider may degrade non-critical usage during emergencies. Early termination fees TBD.
tara: Launch gating: 1) pooled SKU in catalog, 2) per-route telemetry visible in Console, 3) invoice preview in billing UI, 4) pilot signed, 5) runbook + alerts for pool_util >85%.
noah: I'll pitch pooled-first + per-route visibility to both pilots Monday.
linh: Dev estimate: pooled-only 4 dev-weeks; pooled+per-route 10 dev-weeks. I'll open RFC for routing changes.
ben: Ops will add dashboards: pool_util, reserved_eviction_rate, reserved_downgrade events. Paging at >90% for 10m.
molly: Product will prepare SKU docs and sample invoices.
tara: Decision: pooled-first launch with per-route billing scoped for Q3. Action owners: Noah, Linh, Molly, Ben, Legal. Pilot-ready target: 4 weeks.
_meta: generated dataset: pooled-first reserved throughput decision
